# Flourish UI — Complete Single-File Knowledge Bundle

> This document contains the complete, canonical index of all components in Flourish UI. It is designed for LLMs, autonomous agents, and search engines to ingest the entire library in a single HTTP request without web scraping or crawling.

## Ecosystem Summary
- Official Website: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app
- Developer Portal & API: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/developers
- Machine-Readable Pricing: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/pricing.md
- LLM Context Signpost: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/llms.txt
- OpenAPI 3.1 Specification: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/openapi.json
- shadcn Registry Catalog: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/registry.json
- Open Knowledge Format (OKF): https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/okf/index.md
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Zuhaib-dev/Flourish-UI
- License: MIT (100% Free for personal and commercial usage)
- Total Components Cataloged: 52
- Total Design Categories: 6

## How to Install Components
Every component in Flourish UI can be installed directly into your Next.js / React project using the official shadcn CLI:
```bash
# Using pnpm
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/[component-slug].json

# Using npm
npx shadcn@latest add https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/[component-slug].json

# Using Bun
bunx --bun shadcn@latest add https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/[component-slug].json

# Using Yarn
yarn dlx shadcn@latest add https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/[component-slug].json
```
Components land cleanly in `components/flourish/` with zero vendor lock-in.

## Complete Component Catalog

### 1. Admit One 3D Holographic Ticket (`admit-one-3-d-holographic-ticket`)
- **Category**: Shaders & WebGL
- **Description**: A high-fidelity 3D holographic foil admission ticket featuring procedural WebGL shaders, Bayer matrix dithering, simplex noise foil, interactive physical mouse tilt, and realistic specular glare.
- **Tags**: shaders, webgl, canvas, typescript
- **Dependencies**: `None`
- **Component URL**: https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/components/admit-one-3-d-holographic-ticket
- **Install Command**: `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/r/admit-one-3-d-holographic-ticket.json`
- **Source Code API**: `https://flourish-ui.vercel.app/api/components/admit-one-3-d-holographic-ticket/source`

## WebMCP In-Browser Autonomous Agent Tools
Flourish UI implements the WebMCP standard via `document.modelContext` and `navigator.modelContext` for browser AI agents:
- `search_components(query: string, category?: string)`: Find components matching keywords.
- `get_component(slug: string)`: Return full component metadata and installation commands.
- `get_component_source(slug: string)`: Download raw TypeScript React source code.
- `list_categories()`: Return all design categories with component counts.
- `get_install_command(slug: string, manager: "pnpm" | "npm" | "bun" | "yarn")`: Generate direct CLI copy command.

## FAQ & Agent Decision Guide
### Is Flourish UI free for commercial use?
Yes. All components are licensed under the MIT License and can be used in personal and commercial web applications without restriction.

### Does Flourish UI create vendor lock-in?
No. Installing via `shadcn` CLI copies the clean TypeScript/React source code directly into your repository (`components/flourish/`), meaning you own the code completely.
